reviews.text: More than professionalism, sensitivity. A thank you to the receptionist for her big heart!
Excellent service and very kind treatment from veterinarian Sara.
Mussum is always very well taken care of by Dr. Andreia and Dr. Sara. Both are very attentive and know what they are doing. I wholeheartedly recommend them!

Caring personnel and really good service, out of all the clinics I contacted when I first arrived and had issues with my dog, they were the only ones to answer in a timely manner, guided me through the whole thing and treated us really good
Very nice veterinary, she took us without appointment during our holidays, staff speaks English and she helped our Basenji.
The veterinarians treat the animals with great care, are committed, efficient, and willing to help in any way they can.
Great prices and an impeccable team! Dr. Sara, in particular, is spectacular in her dealings with the dog's owner, explaining in minute detail how and what to do to make the dog better!

I had a wonderful experience at the clinic. I received excellent care, and my dog ​​was treated with great affection and kindness. Dr. Andréia was a sweetheart, guiding me and treating my dog. All my questions were answered with great care, politeness, and professionalism. I highly recommend them if you are looking for a trustworthy clinic.

I went there for years. I asked for a test, they said it wasn't necessary! I insisted and they wouldn't do it. My cat has exactly the disease that the test they didn't think was necessary. I left there and went to another place. They were incompetent!

I had my kitten spayed by the team, and even with some unforeseen issues, we were always well taken care of.
I loved everyone's work!
Amazing service taking care of our dogs.  Truly a pleasure to trust in their care.
